title: Native geometric evaluation of compact-support systems
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, A_n its positive integer-ring quotients, and c=(j,p) a compactification X to Y [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On the ringed sequence sites take the native exact extension J along j and separately right-derived direct image P along p [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. There is a specified natural isomorphism (J followed by P) followed by evaluation at n to evaluation at n followed by intrinsic compact support F_n [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. The direct-image model comparison is fixed by the constant-sheaf adjunction, and the open model comparison by the adjunction unit.

source.place: Original tower proof steps 2 and 3: geometric evaluation before the transition calculation.

proof.text: Identify the ordinary direct-image coefficient map using the sheaf adjunction homEquiv inverse law. Identify the two ordinary open extensions by left-adjoint uniqueness and the constant open pullback model.
Compose native evalP and evalJ with right-derived and exact-derived model isomorphisms. Insert functor associators to obtain the specified evaluation.

def compactSupportSystemEvaluation {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (c : Compactification f) (n : ℕ) :
    (ProEtale.VaryingRing.J (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) c.i ⋙
      ProEtale.VaryingRing.P (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) c.g) ⋙
      coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation.{u, u} l E Y n ≅
    coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation.{u, u} l E X n ⋙
      sfIntrinsicCompactSupport c (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
